analysis_profile_requirements.requirement: Score timestamped probabilities, event boundaries or detections on a frozen cohort.
Include quiet/active speech, idle noise, known positives/negatives and onset/offset delay strata.
Verify independent state, exact source intervals, availability and cross-hop behavior.
Record dropped/stale events and no stale cross-epoch event revival.
Reject malformed, missing and nonfinite inputs; keep validity separate from nonspeech.
Measure paced target-device timing/resources; separate callback suitability from compute speed.
Record missing, invalid, nonfinite and adverse controls without qualifying the candidate.

asset_requirements.notes: Exact upstream PulseVAD source revision with reviewed license text and per-file digests; no local checkout is pinned.
Approved runtime or exact ONNX/TorchScript/C asset for the target platform with SHA-256 and execution contract; none present.
Exact model/weight/graph identity, byte count, SHA-256, and interface contract; none pinned locally.
Reviewed upstream license/redistribution/notice terms for code and assets; claim is not accepted as evidence.
Rights-cleared, label-complete held-out cohort with frozen outputs and stratified analysis scoring.

caller_asset_contract.notes: Runtime/model/config/rights/terms files must exist at absolute paths with matching SHA-256 and a 40-hex source_revision before any future processing. No execution occurs in this package.

exact_blockers.requirement: Provide an exact reviewed PulseVAD source revision with immutable commit, license text, and per-file digests; no local pinned source exists.
Provide an approved runtime or exact ONNX/TorchScript/C asset with platform, version, SHA-256, and execution contract; no runtime/asset is present.
Provide exact model/weight/graph identity with SHA-256, byte count, and input/output contract; no pinned local artifact exists.
Clear code/model/data/output redistribution and usage rights before any integration or distribution.
Provide a rights-cleared, label-complete held-out cohort with frozen candidate outputs and stratified analysis scoring; no cohort is present.
Produce approved reference/parity outputs and analysis-profile quality evidence against the exact runtime; no local output exists.
Measure paced target-device timing/resources including the 200 ms window buffering floor under an approved runtime; no timing evidence exists.
Complete opt-in external-adapter/provider intake, descriptor/registry review, and independent public-surface/release decision before any exposure; this package makes no such change.

gates.requirement: An exact reviewed PulseVAD source revision, license text, and redistribution terms are pinned for intended use.
Exact runtime/model/graph artifacts or immutable identifiers, SHA-256 where distributable, and rights/redistribution records are complete.
A rights-cleared, label-complete held-out cohort with frozen outputs is available for analysis-profile scoring.
Approved reference/parity outputs are captured from the exact runtime/configuration on frozen inputs.
Timestamped probabilities/events, onset/offset, stratified FP/FN, validity separation, and state/interval integrity are scored on the held-out cohort.
Paced target-device timing/resources and availability, including 200 ms window buffering implications, are measured independently of compute speed.
Explicit opt-in adapter/provider intake, descriptor/registry review, and independent public-surface decision are complete.
Explicit default selection, resource/deadline evidence, and release/public-benchmark approval are recorded; this package is off by default.

qualification.reason: No pinned PulseVAD source, exact runtime/weights, rights-cleared cohort, parity, or paced timing evidence is present; no qualifying result exists.

stable_fields.acceptance: Apply the analysis acceptance profile; record exact scope, evidence, failure/control results, and remaining release gates. A readiness conclusion with an exact external blocker is an accepted investigation handoff; it does not close the conditional implementation.
stable_fields.deliverable: Verify runnable source, exact assets, permitted scope, task geometry and matched evidence. Then reproduce the exact model/runtime as a caller-supplied-asset reference and add an opt-in SDK adapter once its prerequisites pass. Record a concrete blocker if feasibility fails.
